images.sourceOwner: Microsoft Foundry model catalog Deploy dialog
images.captureScope: Full Deploy dialog for an open model showing Deployment type Global Managed Compute and the Deployment template list of GPU SKUs
images.cropStatus: Single uncropped screenshot; a red box was drawn around the Deployment template field; displayed values not redrawn or altered
images.proves: In the Foundry catalog, an open model is deployed by choosing Deployment type Global Managed Compute and a Deployment template that fixes the GPU SKU (NVIDIA A100, H100, 2xA100, 2xH100, AMD MI300X, 2xMI300X).
images.doesNotProve: Network behavior, the measured run's deployment identity (qwen--qwen3-32b on H100_80GB is recorded in evidence/raw/control-plane.json), or production readiness; those claims require the code-path evidence.

redactions: None required: the dialog shows no account, project, endpoint, identity, tenant, or subscription identifiers
captureMethod: Single screenshot of the Microsoft Foundry model catalog Deploy dialog with the Deployment template dropdown expanded; a red highlight box was added around that field and nothing else was altered.

explanatoryDiagram.incrementalValue: Combines the measured public-block/private-allow differential with the documented Foundry account boundary; the official diagram covers broader inbound and outbound isolation instead of this measured run.
explanatoryDiagram.doesNotProve: Packet-level path instrumentation, Managed Compute pod placement, or egress routing.
